deals.name: Magnolia's On The Bay
deals.deal: Bay Bar happy hour Tue-Fri 2-5pm and Sat-Sun 12-5pm: featured martinis $10, house wine $5 off, call cocktails, mimosas, Bloody Marys and sangria $4 off, craft drafts $3 off. Bay bites include oysters $15.90/dozen, shrimp cocktail $11.90, and $10 off listed sushi rolls.

deals.name: One Barrel
deals.deal: Happy hour 6 days a week: drink specials from open to 6pm (house wine, wells, and house sangria $6; $1 off draft; rotating rose, brut, and Just Peachy $7). Food specials 3-6pm include jalapeno artichoke dip $11 and Korean BBQ pork bites $12.

deals.name: The Waverly
deals.deal: Advertised everyday happy hour 11am-6pm (list updated Oct 1, 2026): upstairs house wines $7 and downstairs house wines $5.

deals.name: Rumours Wine Bar
deals.deal: Happy hour Wed-Thu 3-6pm: $1 off 6 oz pours and $2 off 9 oz pours. Wine Flight Wednesday 5-close: four 3 oz wines $25. Thursday 5-close: selected bottle plus small charcuterie $35. Saturday open-bottle night: $5 for 6 oz and $8 for 9 oz.

deals.name: San Marco
deals.deal: Happy hour 1:30-5:30pm, closed Mondays. Tuesday 1:30-9pm half off bottles of wine. Wednesday 1:30-9pm half off all drinks for ladies night.

deals.name: Lock 'N Key Restaurant
deals.deal: Posted weekly specials Sep 28-Oct 4, 2026 (still the listed week on Oct 4): lunch soup and jalapeno-popper tuna croissant or hot-honey chicken flatbread $19.90; dinner pork ribeye $25.90, grilled duck $34.90. Order online for takeout.

shop.name: Publix
shop.deal: Advertised ad week of Oct 8-14, 2026 (some stores Oct 7-13): BOGO Hero snack-sized Gala apples, Publix guacamole, Publix salsa, tricolor peppers, two-dozen cookies, Perdue thin-sliced chicken breast, Publix pork Boston butt, and DiGiorno stuffed-crust pizza.
